que-es-foll.question: What is Foll and what is it for?
que-es-foll.answer: Foll is a peaceful monitoring platform for older adults. It lets caregivers monitor the wearable device status in real time, receive immediate alerts for a possible fall, and coordinate care with other family members from the web.

registrar-abuelito.question: How do I register an older adult on the platform?
registrar-abuelito.answer: Go to My Elders and tap Register Elder. Fill in name, ID number, age, blood type, and if applicable, conditions and medications. Once the profile is created, you can link the physical device to activate monitoring.

vincular-dispositivo.question: How do I link the wearable device to an elder?
vincular-dispositivo.answer: In My Elders, open the elder's card and select Link Device. Enter the hardware's numeric ID (for example, 1001) shown on the device or provided by the administrator. Only the primary caregiver can perform this linking.

telemetria-vivo.question: What does the "LIVE" telemetry on the elder's card mean?
telemetria-vivo.answer: It shows the device's current status: battery level, whether it is charging, and whether it is online or offline. This information updates automatically with each device heartbeat, without needing to reload the page.

dispositivo-offline.question: Why does the device appear as Offline?
dispositivo-offline.answer: It may be due to a dead battery, lack of signal, the device being off, or being out of coverage. Check the battery level on the card and, if it persists, move the device to an area with better signal or connect it to power. You will also receive a notification if the system detects a disconnection.

bateria-baja.question: What happens when the battery is low?
bateria-baja.answer: If the battery drops to 20% or less and is not charging, the card highlights it in red and you may receive a low battery alert. You should charge the device as soon as possible to avoid interrupting monitoring.

alerta-caida.question: What happens when a fall is detected?
alerta-caida.answer: You will receive an immediate on-screen alert (red overlay), a notification in the header bell, and the elder's card will be highlighted in red. All caregivers linked to the patient see the same alert at the same time so they can coordinate.

atender-vs-falsa.question: What is the difference between "Respond to emergency" and "False alarm"?
atender-vs-falsa.answer: Respond to emergency means you are on your way or already attending to the older adult; it closes the incident as resolved and notifies the rest of the team. False alarm dismisses the event when it was a sudden movement or another cause, not a real fall. Both options close the alert for all caregivers.

varios-cuidadores-alerta.question: If several caregivers try to respond to the same fall, what happens?
varios-cuidadores-alerta.answer: The system is built for this: when one caregiver responds or marks a false alarm, the incident is closed on the server and the others receive a notice indicating who took charge. It is not necessary for everyone to confirm separately.

historial-reportes.question: Where can I see the fall history and clinical reports?
historial-reportes.answer: In Fall Log you will find details of recent events with date, type, and observations. In Clinical Reports you can generate a monthly report per patient and download it as a PDF to share with doctors or family members.

invitar-cuidador.question: How do I invite another family member to care for an elder?
invitar-cuidador.answer: From My Elders use Link Family Member and enter the elder's ID number, or go to Invitations and send a request indicating your relationship (child, family member, neighbor, etc.). The primary caregiver must approve the invitation before you get access.

roles-cuidador.question: What do Official Primary, Guest Primary, and Secondary mean?
roles-cuidador.answer: Official Primary is whoever registered the older adult and has full control, including device linking. Guest Primary is a caregiver who was temporarily given shared primary control. Secondary can view alerts and collaborate, but with limited permissions (for example, cannot link hardware).

codigo-qr.question: What is the QR code on the elder's card for?
codigo-qr.answer: The QR code lets another user join the care team by scanning it from the Foll mobile app. It is a quick way to share access to the patient's profile without typing the ID manually.
